gen-gf-phudu-gf-rosario: Rosario reads friendly and open, its c-shapes never curling shut, so text feels easy going down. Phudu's heavy, uniform outlines sit above it and give the page a confident headline.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ruluko: Approachable describes Ruluko, whose wide, open counters let the text breathe, while Phudu holds a bold single-width line overhead. They share the page comfortably.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sansation: Phudu draws its bold display letters with a tube-like thickness that holds through every bend, with generous openings at each curve. Sansation follows underneath, a plain sans with no ink pooling where curves turn.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sarabun: Chunky, friendly, and unfussy: Phudu keeps its joins as thick as its stems, so nothing thins out at the corners. Sarabun brings the clear, wide-bowled sans that makes the bold heading feel grounded.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sarala: Phudu opens the page with bold, distinctive display letters. Sarala, a sans-serif with distinct gaps in its letters and a thickness like neon glass tubing, gives the pair its strongest quality: a shared, steady glow of line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Bold and a bit quirky, Phudu holds its line thickness all the way around each curve. And Sawarabi Gothic, a sans-serif with open jaws on its curves, would carry a longer passage smoothly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-shanti: Thick, round, and confident: Phudu swaps hairline joins for full-width connections at every turn. Shanti follows as a plain sans with a generous entry into the e, keeping the page modern and tidy.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-shippori-antique: Shippori Antique reads modern and open, a monoweight sans-serif skeleton with bowls like a ladle tipped toward you. Bump its size up a notch against Phudu's bold heading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Phudu's most distinctive trait is its ballpoint-plain line, with generous openings on every curve and no pressure-driven variation. Shippori Antique B1 keeps a stencil-brush sans line with daylight through each curve, so a longer passage moves along neutrally.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro reads neutral and modern, its open apertures keeping every curve easy to follow. And Phudu's diagonals match its stems, so a longer passage under that bold heading flows without friction.
